reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: tenor-lead arr., George Kirbye: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source. Imported from CCEH tune 000096 (the melody read from 000096a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 14); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Thomas Este has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1592, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000096a.nwc).
